title: Understanding Odds
text: Odds are a way of expressing the likelihood of an event happening compared to it not happening. If the odds of an event are $$4$$, it means the event is $$4$$ times more likely to happen than not happen. Can you think about how this relates to probabilities?

title: Interpreting the Coefficients
text: The coefficients in a logistic regression model tell us how the log-odds of the outcome change with a one-unit change in the predictor variable. What does the coefficient for sex tell you about the odds of survival for males versus females?

title: Calculating Odds for Females
text: If the odds of survival for a male passenger are $$m$$, how would you express the odds for a female passenger using the coefficient for sex?
